unit_exponents:
theorem unit_exponents {D : Type*} [AddCommGroup D] (X L H : D) (h : H + (L - X) = X) :
    H = X + X - L
regret_unit_exponents:
theorem regret_unit_exponents {D : Type*} [AddCommGroup D] (X L : D) :
    (X + X - (X + X - L) = L) ∧ ((X + X - L) + (L - X) + (L - X) = L)
inverse_loss:
theorem inverse_loss (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (f : E → EReal) :
    scaledLoss c⁻¹ (scaledLoss c f) = f
proper_scaled_loss:
theorem proper_scaled_loss (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (f : E → EReal) (hf : SourceProper f) :
    SourceProper (scaledLoss c f)
subgradient_scaled:
theorem subgradient_scaled (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (f : E → EReal) (hf : SourceProper f) (y g : E) (hg : g ∈ SourceSubdifferential f (c • y)) :
    c • g ∈ SourceSubdifferential (scaledLoss c f) y
subdifferentiable_scaled:
theorem subdifferentiable_scaled (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (f : E → EReal) (hf : BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.SubdifferentiableOn V f) :
    BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.SubdifferentiableOn V (scaledLoss c f)
hasGradientAt_scaled:
theorem hasGradientAt_scaled (c : ℝ) (f : E → ℝ) (y g : E) (hf : HasGradientAt f g (c • y)) :
    HasGradientAt (fun z => f (c • z)) (c • g) y
gradient_scaled:
theorem gradient_scaled (c : ℝ) (f : E → ℝ) (y : E) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (c • y)) :
    gradient (fun z => f (c • z)) y = c • gradient f (c • y)
step_scaling:
theorem step_scaling (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℝ) (x g : E) :
    c⁻¹ • (x - η • g) = c⁻¹ • x - (η / c ^ 2) • (c • g)
wrong_step_scaling:
theorem wrong_step_scaling (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℝ) (x g : E) :
    c • (c⁻¹ • x - η • (c • g)) = x - (c ^ 2 * η) • g
scaled_eta_positive:
theorem scaled_eta_positive (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) (hη : 0 < η t) :
    0 < scaledEta c η t
history_scaling:
theorem history_scaling (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (t : ℕ) :
    history V (scaledEta c η) (fun s => scaledLoss c (loss s)) (c⁻¹ • x₁) (scaledPolicy c p) t = fun i => c⁻¹ • history V η loss x₁ p t i
output_scaling:
theorem output_scaling (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (t : ℕ) :
    output V (scaledEta c η) (fun s => scaledLoss c (loss s)) (c⁻¹ • x₁) (scaledPolicy c p) t = c⁻¹ • output V η loss x₁ p t
selected_scaling:
theorem selected_scaling (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (t : ℕ) :
    selected V (scaledEta c η) (fun s => scaledLoss c (loss s)) (c⁻¹ • x₁) (scaledPolicy c p) t = c • selected V η loss x₁ p t
legal_feedback_scaling:
theorem legal_feedback_scaling (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (T : ℕ) (hproper : ∀ t < T, SourceProper (loss t)) (hlegal : LegalFeedback V η loss x₁ p T) :
    LegalFeedback V (scaledEta c η) (fun s => scaledLoss c (loss s)) (c⁻¹ • x₁) (scaledPolicy c p) T
loss_value_scaling:
theorem loss_value_scaling (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (t : ℕ) :
    scaledLoss c (loss t) (output V (scaledEta c η) (fun s => scaledLoss c (loss s)) (c⁻¹ • x₁) (scaledPolicy c p) t) = loss t (output V η loss x₁ p t)
regret_scaling:
theorem regret_scaling (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (u : E) (T : ℕ) :
    regret V (scaledEta c η) (fun s => scaledLoss c (loss s)) (c⁻¹ • x₁) (scaledPolicy c p) (c⁻¹ • u) T = regret V η loss x₁ p u T
wrong_step_output:
theorem wrong_step_output (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (t : ℕ) :
    c • output V η (fun s => scaledLoss c (loss s)) (c⁻¹ • x₁) (scaledPolicy c p) t = output V (fun s => c ^ 2 * η s) loss x₁ p t
distance_square_scaling:
theorem distance_square_scaling (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (x u : E) :
    ‖c⁻¹ • x - c⁻¹ • u‖ ^ 2 = ‖x - u‖ ^ 2 / c ^ 2
energy_scaling:
theorem energy_scaling (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (T : ℕ) :
    (∑ t ∈ range T, ‖selected V (scaledEta c η) (fun s => scaledLoss c (loss s)) (c⁻¹ • x₁) (scaledPolicy c p) t‖ ^ 2) = c ^ 2 * (∑ t ∈ range T, ‖selected V η loss x₁ p t‖ ^ 2)
upper_bound_scaling:
theorem upper_bound_scaling (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (A B η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    BanditRL.OnlineOptimalStep.upperBound (A / c ^ 2) (c ^ 2 * B) (η / c ^ 2) = BanditRL.OnlineOptimalStep.upperBound A B η
regret_fixed_scaled:
theorem regret_fixed_scaled (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (T : ℕ) (hloss : ∀ t < T, BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.SubdifferentiableOn V (loss t)) (hlegal : LegalFeedback V (fun _ => η) loss x₁ p T) (u : E) :
    regret V (scaledEta c (fun _ => η)) (fun s => scaledLoss c (loss s)) (c⁻¹ • x₁) (scaledPolicy c p) (c⁻¹ • u) T ≤ ‖x₁ - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η) + η / 2 * (∑ t ∈ range T, ‖selected V (fun _ => η) loss x₁ p t‖ ^ 2) - ‖output V (fun _ => η) loss x₁ p T - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η)
